properties.site-address: County Grounds Depot, Cannock Road, Cannock
properties.notes: Site recently subject of disposal by Staffordshire County Council as surplus to requirements. CH/19/010 is full planning application for the construction of a three storey care home (C2) for 91 rooms. Capacity of 49 dwellings based upon calculation specified in NPPG using the average number of adults living in households, from published census data (91 bedrooms/1.86 local ratio)
